stories.title: “Much more than just a symbolic gesture”: Flintshire signs the Young Carers Covenant
stories.summary: Around 800 young carers are currently known to services in Flintshire, and some of them took on caring responsibilities from the age of four. Flintshire County Council has signed the Young Carers Covenant, a UK-wide pledge covering young carers and young adult carers up to the age of 25. Councillors voted unanimously to sign it

stories.title: Flint IT firm Layer 4 signs three-year partnership with Chester FC
stories.summary: A company based in Flint has signed a three-year deal with Chester FC. Layer 4 Limited, a managed IT services firm, will be a club partner for the next three seasons. stories.title: Finger-prick test could help paramedics spot major strokes
stories.summary: The Welsh Ambulance Service is taking part in a new study aimed at quickly identifying patients with a specific type of stroke through a simple finger-prick blood test. stories.title: Struggling Flintshire families must pay for Holiday Hunger replacement scheme
stories.summary: Families facing food poverty through the summer holidays will now have to pay for the support they receive from Flintshire County Council. stories.title: Welsh Government opens consultation on holiday let letting rules
stories.summary: Holiday let owners across Wales have until 23 October to respond to a Welsh Government consultation on the rule that decides whether they pay business rates or council tax.
